#!/bin/sh
# Claude Code status line — model name + context window progress bar
# Example output: Claude Opus 4.6 [████████░░░░░░░░] 52%

input=$(cat)
model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"')
used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')

if [ -z "$used" ]; then
  printf "%s" "$model"
else
  used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$used")
  filled=$(( used_int * 16 / 100 ))
  empty=$(( 16 - filled ))
  bar=""
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt $filled ]; do
    bar="${bar}█"
    i=$(( i + 1 ))
  done
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt $empty ]; do
    bar="${bar}░"
    i=$(( i + 1 ))
  done
  printf "%s [%s] %d%%" "$model" "$bar" "$used_int"
fi

#!/bin/sh
# Claude Code status line — model name + context window bar + monthly usage credits
# Example: Claude Opus 5 [████████░░░░░░░░] 52% · credits $1,034.10
#
# Usage credits come from Claude Code's own cached /api/oauth/usage payload in
# ~/.claude.json (.cachedUsageUtilization). Claude Code refreshes that cache when
# it fetches usage (e.g. on /usage or /status), so an age is shown once it's old.

CONFIG="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME}/.claude.json"
[ -f "$CONFIG" ] || CONFIG="$HOME/.claude.json"

input=$(cat)
model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"')
used=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')

# --- model + context window bar ---
if [ -z "$used" ]; then
  line="$model"
else
  used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$used")
  filled=$(( used_int * 16 / 100 ))
  [ $filled -gt 16 ] && filled=16
  [ $filled -lt 0 ] && filled=0
  empty=$(( 16 - filled ))
  bar=""
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt $filled ]; do bar="${bar}█"; i=$(( i + 1 )); done
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt $empty ]; do bar="${bar}░"; i=$(( i + 1 )); done
  line=$(printf "%s [%s] %d%%" "$model" "$bar" "$used_int")
fi

# --- monthly usage credits ---
# tsv: used_minor <tab> exponent <tab> limit_minor(-1 = none) <tab> currency <tab> fetchedAtMs
credits_tsv=$(jq -r '
  (.cachedUsageUtilization // {}) as $c
  | ($c.utilization // {}) as $u
  | ($u.spend // {}) as $s
  | ($u.extra_usage // {}) as $e
  | ((if ($s.used | type) == "object" then $s.used.amount_minor else null end) // $e.used_credits) as $usedm
  | ((if ($s.used | type) == "object" then $s.used.exponent else null end) // $e.decimal_places // 2) as $exp
  | ((if ($s.limit | type) == "object" then $s.limit.amount_minor
      elif ($s.limit | type) == "number" then $s.limit
      else null end) // $e.monthly_limit) as $limm
  | ((if ($s.used | type) == "object" then $s.used.currency else null end) // $e.currency // "USD") as $cur
  | if ($usedm | type) != "number" then empty
    else [$usedm, $exp, ($limm // -1), $cur, ($c.fetchedAtMs // 0)] | @tsv
    end
' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null)

if [ -n "$credits_tsv" ]; then
  credits=$(printf '%s\n' "$credits_tsv" | awk -F'\t' -v now_ms="$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 ))" '
    function money(minor, exp, cur,   div, i, sym, fmt, s, p, n, out) {
      div = 1; for (i = 0; i < exp; i++) div *= 10
      sym = (cur == "USD" ? "$" : (cur == "EUR" ? "\342\202\254" : (cur == "GBP" ? "\302\243" : cur " ")))
      fmt = sprintf("%%.%df", exp)
      s = sprintf(fmt, minor / div)
      split(s, p, ".")
      n = p[1]; out = ""
      while (length(n) > 3) { out = "," substr(n, length(n) - 2) out; n = substr(n, 1, length(n) - 3) }
      out = n out
      return sym out (exp > 0 ? "." p[2] : "")
    }
    {
      usedm = $1; exp = $2; limm = $3; cur = $4; at = $5
      out = "credits " money(usedm, exp, cur)
      if (limm >= 0) {
        pct = (limm > 0 ? usedm / limm * 100 : 100)
        out = out "/" money(limm, exp, cur) sprintf(" (%d%%)", pct + 0.5)
      }
      if (at > 0) {
        age_min = int((now_ms - at) / 60000)
        if (age_min >= 30) {
          if (age_min < 120) out = out sprintf(" (%dm ago)", age_min)
          else out = out sprintf(" (%dh ago)", int(age_min / 60))
        }
      }
      print out
    }
  ')
  [ -n "$credits" ] && line="$line \302\267 $credits"
fi

printf "%b" "$line"
SCRIPT

content.text:
Done — `~/.claude/statusline-command.sh` now shows month-to-date usage credits:

```
Claude Opus 5 [████████░░░░░░░░] 52% · credits $1,034.10
```

With a spend cap configured it renders `credits $1,034.10/$2,000.00 (52%)`. Your account has `monthly_limit: null` (unlimited), so only the spent amount shows. Old script backed up at `statusline-command.sh.bak`; `settings.json` already pointed here, so no config change was needed.

**Where the number comes from:** the statusline JSON Claude Code feeds to the script only carries `rate_limits.five_hour` / `seven_day` — no credits field. So the script reads Claude Code's own cached `/api/oauth/usage` payload from `~/.claude.json` (`.cachedUsageUtilization.utilization.spend`, falling back to `.extra_usage` for the older schema). No network call, no token handling, ~15 ms per render.

**The one caveat:** that cache is refreshed only when Claude Code fetches usage (opening `/usage`, `/status`, `/usage-credits`), not on a timer — so it can go stale. Rather than hide that, the script appends the age once it's over 30 minutes old (`credits $1,034.10 (2h ago)`). Run `/usage` to force a refresh. Restart or `/statusline` reload to see it in this session.
